title: How To Disable YouTube Shorts From Your Feed - BGR
summary: Unfortunately, youtube.com on your desktop doesn't include a Time Management feature like the YouTube app. To disable Shorts from your feed, you can try clicking the three-dot menu in the Shorts section and selecting Show Fewer Shorts.
